comparison_scope: First-stop scheduled departures only; intermediate stop times on the reference page are estimated.
source_authority: Secondary copy of a BEST-published timetable carried by Chalo, according to airportbus.in. The reference website states it is not affiliated with BEST or the airport.
license_status: No explicit license for the source page data was identified. Stored here as a small, attributed factual timetable extract for research comparison.
limitations: The feed archive retrieval date and exact upstream GTFS version remain unknown.

The source page identifies the external route as 321 while the GTFS route label is 321 LTD; the shared Mahim origin and Barve Nagar continuation make this a candidate route match, not an exact identifier match.
The source page says its schedule was taken from Chalo on 2026-10-16; its effective date is not stated.
The GTFS feed has one calendar applying the same trip set every day and no calendar_dates.txt was supplied.
Only departure times at Mahim Bus Station are compared; no stop-by-stop timetable validation is performed.
